info.name: NestVault API
info.description: Example requests for the NestVault REST API (/api/v1). Import tests/api/local.postman_environment.json too. The OpenAPI document (docs/api/openapi.json) is the complete reference; see tests/api/README.md.

request.description: Liveness check. No authentication, no data.

Closed unless ALLOW_SIGNUP=true or a valid x-invite-token header is sent (403 signup_closed). Creates an unverified account and NO session (token is null): a verification link is emailed (Mailpit, http://localhost:8025) and sign-in answers 403 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED until it is used. An email that already has an account answers the same as a new one. Passwords: 12+ chars, not common (PASSWORD_TOO_COMMON), not based on the email (PASSWORD_BASED_ON_EMAIL). 5 / 15 min per IP and per email.
Sets the nv.session_token cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, 30 days). Postman keeps it in the cookie jar. An account whose email is not confirmed answers 403 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED.

item.name: Sign in - rate limited (6th failed attempt)

request.description: Rate limit demo (control 11): send this request 6 times in a row with a wrong password. The first 5 answer 401, the 6th answers 429 with a Retry-After header (seconds) and keeps answering 429 until the 15 minute window ends. Use an email that is not the one you stay signed in with.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 429) { pm.test('Retry-After is a positive number of seconds', () => pm.expect(Number(pm.response.headers.get('Retry-After'))).to.be.above(0)); }

request.description: The current session, or null.
Requires a session. The new password must be 12-128 characters and not in a known breach.
Deletes the session and clears the cookie.

Always 200 with the same body, whether or not the account exists. The email (in Mailpit, http://localhost:8025) links to /recuperar/<token>: single use, valid for 1 hour. Limited to 5 per 15 min per IP and per email (429 + Retry-After).
Paste the token from the link of the email into the `resetToken` collection variable. Uses the token up (a second call answers 400), ends every session of the user and emails a notice.

exec: pm.test('status is 200 (first use) or 400 (used or expired)', () => pm.expect([200, 400]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: Same neutral answer whether or not the address belongs to an unverified account. The link opens /verificar/<token> (valid 24 hours). Shares the reset rate limit.
Paste the token of the /verificar/<token> link into the `verifyToken` collection variable. 200 marks the email as verified; a bad or expired token answers 401.
The signed-in user (id, name, email, emailVerified) and their pools (id, name, role, memberCount, lastActivityAt), most recently active first.
Only `name` can change; any other field answers 400.
Active sessions, the current one marked. No token, hash or full IP.
204 when it is yours; 404 for somebody else's, an unknown or a malformed id. The Origin header is added by the collection pre-request script.

exec: pm.test('204 or 404 when it is already gone', () => pm.expect([204,404]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: Requires others=true (400 without it). The current session stays.
Wrong current password answers 400; limited to 5 / 15 min per user. With revokeOtherSessions every other session ends and a notice is emailed.
The link goes to the new address; the email changes only once it is used. Same answer if the address is taken.
Creates a pool; the caller becomes its owner. The name is trimmed, 1-60 characters. Extra fields (role, id, ownerId) answer 400; 409 beyond 10 owned pools.

item.name: Create a pool with extra fields (400)

request.description: Mass assignment is refused: role and ownerId are never read from the body.
Needs members.invite (owner, admin). Sends a pt-PT email (see Mailpit at http://localhost:8025) with a single-use link valid for 7 days. The role cannot be above your own. 20 invites a day per pool.
Mass assignment is refused: poolId, id and invitedBy are never read from the body.
Invites that were neither accepted nor cancelled, newest first (expired ones too, so they can be resent).
New link and a new 7-day expiry; the previous link stops working. Counts towards the 20 a day.
The link stops working. An id of another pool, an accepted or an unknown invite answers 404.

item.name: Accept an invite (token from the email)

request.description: Sign in as the invited address first (verified email). The token is the last segment of the /convite/{token} link in the email. Unknown, expired, used or someone else's token: the same 404.
Every member may list. The emails are only filled for owners and admins (null for everybody else). Saves the first other member as memberId for the requests below.

exec: pm.test('exactly one row is mine', () => pm.expect(members.filter((m) => m.isYou)).to.have.length(1));

request.description: Needs members.manage (owner, admin). Admins cannot touch owners or hand out owner (403); nobody changes their own role (403); the last owner cannot lose the role (409). The member's sessions in this pool end. The body is the role (and your password, only when making an owner) and nothing else.

item.name: Change a role with extra fields (400)

request.description: Mass assignment is refused: poolId and userId come from the URL, never from the body.

Making an owner needs your password (userPassword, kept as a secret in the environment): a missing or wrong one answers 400 with an issue on password and counts towards the password-attempt limit. For any other role the password is not read.

exec: pm.test('the member is an owner now', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().role).to.eql('owner'));

request.description: Needs members.manage. Admins cannot remove owners (403); leaving yourself is the leave request (403). The person gets 404 on the pool at once, their sessions in it end, and what they created stays.
Any member may leave. The only owner cannot (409): transfer the pool first. Coming back needs a new invite.

item.name: Transfer the pool to another member

request.description: Needs pool.transfer (owners). Confirms with your password (userPassword, kept as a secret in the environment): a wrong one answers 400 with an issue on password. You become an admin unless keepOwnership is true.

exec: pm.test('the caller is an admin now', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().role).to.eql('admin'));

item.name: List the people of the household

request.description: Any member. Oldest first.

Needs accounts.write (owner, admin). Aliases are stored upper case without accents (max 10, 3–60 chars). Without a color the next unused palette colour is used. userId must be a member of this pool. Strict body: poolId, id or any other field answers 400.
Needs accounts.write. Fields left out stay; userId: null unlinks the member.
Needs accounts.write. 409 while accounts or sub-accounts still name the person.
Any member. Gives the defaults (window 3, taxes 28, EUR) while the pool never saved any.

Needs settings.write (owner, admin). Partial and strict: fields left out stay; fxOverrides replaces the whole map ({} clears it). Taxes are decimal strings 0-100, rates EUR per unit, window 0-30 days. poolId or any other field answers 400.
Any member. The EUR rate of each currency on a day (asOf optional, today by default): the pool override, else the newest market rate, else the seed.

exec: pm.test('each rate has exactly the DTO fields', () => b.rates.forEach(r => pm.expect(Object.keys(r).sort()).to.eql(['currency','date','marketRate','rate','source'])));

request.description: Any member. balance is a decimal string in the account currency today, balanceEur the same value in EUR with the pool's rates.

Needs accounts.write (owner, admin). holderIds (at least one) must be people of this pool (GET holders). IBAN is normalized, mod-97 checked and unique in the pool (409). Term deposit is EUR only. subAccounts only for brokerage. Strict body.
Any member. An account of another pool answers 404.
Needs accounts.write. Fields left out stay; holderIds replaces the owners. 409 for a duplicate IBAN, for dropping the person of a sub-account and for changing the type while sub-accounts exist.
Needs accounts.write. Brokerage accounts only; holderId must own the account; names unique in the account (409).
Needs accounts.write. Fields left out stay; holderId null clears the person.
Needs accounts.write. 409 while it has operations.
Needs accounts.write. Holder links and sub-accounts go with it; 409 while the account has movements.
Any member. price is the newest price dated on or before ?asOf (today by default).
Needs portfolios.write (owner, admin). Ticker is upper-cased and unique in the pool (409). Strict body.
Any member. An asset of another pool answers 404.
Needs portfolios.write. Fields left out stay.

item.name: Set the price of a day

request.description: Needs prices.write (owner, admin, member). Adds the price of the day or replaces it; a future date answers 400.
Any member. Newest first; ?from, ?to and ?limit are optional.
Needs prices.write. By ticker, 1-500 entries, one transaction: an unknown ticker or any invalid entry rejects the whole batch (400).

item.name: Remove the price of a day

request.description: Needs prices.write.
Needs portfolios.write. Its prices go with it; 409 while operations use it.
Any member. The 25 global categories (global true, systemKey set, no name: the name comes from i18n) plus the pool's own, each with this pool's budget, colour and hidden flag.

exec: pm.test('25 global categories at least', () => pm.expect(list.filter(c => c.global).length).to.eql(25));

request.description: Needs categories.write (owner, admin). Belongs to this pool only; name unique in the pool (409). Strict body: poolId, id, systemKey answer 400.
Needs categories.write. Only the pool's own categories: a global one answers 403.
Needs categories.write. For any category the pool sees (global too); belongs to this pool only. null clears a budget or colour.
Needs categories.write. Only the pool's own: a global one answers 403 (hide it instead). replacement receives its transactions and is required while any use it.
Any member. Filters: month (yyyy-mm), accountId, categoryId (or none), kind, q (literal text), withNotes. sort is date|amount|description (anything else answers 400). Pass nextCursor back as cursor.

Needs transactions.write (owner, admin, member). Without categoryId the rules choose one; with one it counts as chosen by hand. A mirror movement in another account within the transfer window is paired as an internal transfer.
Needs transactions.write. categoryId sets it by hand (null hands it back to the rules); transfer fixes the internal-transfer flag (false releases the other side of a pair).
Needs transactions.write. The other side of a transfer is released.
Any member. In the order the rules are tried.
Needs categories.write (owner, admin). Keyword matched at the start of a word; category is global or the pool's own (another pool's answers 400); accountId optional.
Needs categories.write. Fields left out stay.
Needs categories.write. ids must be every rule of the pool, once each, in the new order.
Needs categories.write. confirm false only previews; a category chosen by hand is never overridden.
Needs categories.write. confirm true applies what the preview showed.
Needs categories.write.
Needs portfolios.write (owner, admin). Name is unique per pool (409). Strict body.
Any member.
Any member.
Needs portfolios.write. Fields left out stay.
Domain summary of all portfolios or one (portfolioId), as of asOf.
409 while it has operations or plans unless ?moveTo=<portfolioId> or ?deleteOps=true.
Needs ops.write (members too). Buys and sells need qty > 0 and a price; dividends need amount.
Net amount, optional gross and tax (negative tax is a refund).
Newest first; filters portfolioId, assetId, accountId, type, from, to, limit.
Any member.
Needs ops.write. The result is validated as a whole.
Needs ops.write.
Needs portfolios.write. day is 1-28.
Any member; optional portfolioId.
Any member.
Needs portfolios.write.

item.name: Run a plan for a month

request.description: Needs ops.write. 201 creates the month's buy; a second run answers 200 with created=false.
Needs portfolios.write. Its buys stay.
Needs accounts.write. Rate and tax are percentages 0-100 with up to 4 decimals; payN/payU and termN/termU come as a number with its unit (m months, d days) or not at all.
Any member. Each product carries depositsCount, capital and the capital-weighted averageRate.
Any member.
Needs accounts.write. Deposits already made keep their own terms.
Needs accounts.write. 409 while a deposit was made with it.

Needs accounts.write. Set termAccountId to a term_deposit account (create one in Accounts). Fields left out are filled from the product; what is sent overrides it (null means none). One deposit per account (409).
Any member.
Any member.
Any member. Interest payments, next payment, maturity and value as of the date (today by default).
Needs accounts.write. The account cannot change.
Needs accounts.write. The account stays.
Needs accounts.write. Net amount above zero, in the account currency. Set savingsAccountId to a savings account.
Any member; optional accountId.
Needs accounts.write.

exec: // Write requests (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) are rejected with 403 unless Origin equals the app origin.
// Postman does not send one by default, so set it for every request in this collection.
